title: Cyan Plex
description: Cyan Plex is a Minecraft (cross) server . Mainly focused on Bangladesh. We try to provide a unique & friendly experience
body:
Cyan Plex﻿ founded in June 2021, is a Minecraft: Java and Bedrock Edition (cross) network that provides players with captivating and unique gameplay. ## What games are there on Cyan Plex? • Survival: Semi-Modded, economy, ranks, grief prevention, etc....
• Bed-Wars: solo, team, various arena The community is very friendly and staff are always online to help you. So what are you waiting for? Join now! IP: **play.cyanplex.net** Port: 19132 (for bedrock) Website: [Click here](https://cyanplex.net/)
Facebook: [Click here](https://www.facebook.com/cyanplex.mc)
Discord: [Click to join](https://discord.cyanplex.net/)
YouTube: [Click to visit](https://www.youtube.com/@cyanplex)
Hope to see you soon!
